<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="right">Exhibit 99.1 </P> <P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">


<IMG SRC="g88769g0217084141702.jpg" ALT="LOGO">
 </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt" ALIGN="center">


<IMG SRC="g88769g0217084142145.jpg" ALT="LOGO">
 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:14pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="center"><B>INNOSPEC REPORTS FOURTH QUARTER AND FULL YEAR 2025 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:14pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="center"><B>FINANCIAL RESULTS </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9.5pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="center"><B><I>Continued strength in
Fuel Specialties with 7&nbsp;percent operating income growth and improved margins </I></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9.5pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="center"><B><I>Sequentially improving results in Performance
Chemicals and Oilfield Services </I></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9.5pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="center"><B><I>Excellent quarterly cash flow of $61.4&nbsp;million generated from operations; Net cash improves to
$292.5&nbsp;million </I></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:9.5pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="center"><B><I>GAAP EPS $1.91 and adjusted <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-GAAP</FONT> EPS $1.50 </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify"><B>Englewood, CO &#8211; February</B><B></B><B>&nbsp;17, 2026</B> &#8211; Innospec Inc. (NASDAQ: IOSP) today announced its financial results for the
fourth quarter and full year ended December&nbsp;31, 2025. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Total revenues for the fourth quarter were $455.6&nbsp;million, a decrease of
2&nbsp;percent from $466.8&nbsp;million in the corresponding period last year. Net income for the quarter was $47.4&nbsp;million, or $1.91 per diluted share compared to a net loss of $70.4&nbsp;million, or $2.80 per diluted share, recorded last year
which was impacted by the buyout of the UK pension scheme. Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter was $55.7&nbsp;million compared to $56.6&nbsp;million reported in the same period a year ago. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Results for this quarter include some special items, which are summarized in the table below. Excluding these items, adjusted <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-GAAP</FONT> EPS in the fourth quarter was $1.50 per diluted share, compared to $1.41 per diluted share a year ago. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Innospec generated cash from operating activities of $61.4&nbsp;million before capital expenditures of $20.5&nbsp;million in the quarter and closed the
year with net cash of $292.5&nbsp;million. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Adjusted EBITDA, income before income taxes excluding special items, net income excluding special items,
and related <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">per-share</FONT> amounts, together with net cash, are <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-GAAP</FONT> financial measures that are defined and reconciled with GAAP results herein and in the schedules
below. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>

</TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">For the full year, total revenues of $1.78&nbsp;billion decreased by 4&nbsp;percent from $1.85&nbsp;billion in the prior
year. Net income for 2025 was $116.6&nbsp;million or $4.67 per diluted share, compared to the prior year net income of $35.6&nbsp;million, or $1.42 per diluted share, which was impacted by the buy out of the UK pension scheme. Adjusted EBITDA for
the year was $203.0&nbsp;million down 10&nbsp;percent from $225.2&nbsp;million in 2024. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Results for the full year include some special items, which
are summarized in the table below. Excluding these items, adjusted <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-GAAP</FONT> EPS for the full year was $5.27 per diluted share, compared to $5.92 per diluted share a year ago. </P>

<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Commenting on the fourth quarter results, Patrick S. Williams, President and Chief Executive Officer,
said, </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">&#8220;This was a good quarter for Innospec with continued strong operating income growth and margin expansion in Fuel Specialties combined
with improving results in Performance Chemicals and Oilfield Services. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Performance Chemicals delivered strong sequential operating income growth as
our margin improvement actions began to take effect together with lower overheads driven by a reduction in personnel related costs. We continue to execute multiple topline, cost and other margin opportunities identified in the business. In addition,
we are accelerating our strong pipeline of new products across all our end markets. We expect these combined efforts to drive further improvement in 2026. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Fuel Specialties had another strong quarter with sales growth and margin improvement, driving a seven percent increase in operating income over the
prior year. As expected, the business has continued to deliver consistently strong results. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Oilfield Services operating income and margins improved
this quarter on a richer sales mix and lower overheads due to lower personnel related costs while sales were down on reduced activity in US completions and in the Middle East. We remain focused on delivering operating income growth in 2026 as Middle
East activity returns, sales from our recent DRA expansion takes effect, and our focus on margin improvement continues. Our outlook does not assume any resumption of Mexico sales in 2026.&#8221; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Revenues in Performance Chemicals of $168.4&nbsp;million were consistent with $169.2&nbsp;million in the fourth quarter of last year, as volume
reductions of 7&nbsp;percent were offset by a positive price/mix of 3&nbsp;percent and a positive currency impact of 4&nbsp;percent. Gross margins of 18.1&nbsp;percent decreased by 4.6 percentage points from the same quarter last year. Operating
income of $17.7&nbsp;million decreased 14&nbsp;percent from $20.6&nbsp;million in the prior year period. For the full year, revenues were up 4&nbsp;percent to $681.4&nbsp;million and operating income decreased 26&nbsp;percent to $61.0&nbsp;million.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Revenues in Fuel Specialties of $194.1&nbsp;million were up 1&nbsp;percent from $191.8&nbsp;million in the fourth quarter of last year. Volumes
were up 8&nbsp;percent with an adverse price/mix of 10&nbsp;percent and a positive currency impact of 3&nbsp;percent. Gross margins of 34.7&nbsp;percent increased by 0.3 percentage points over last year. Operating income of $37.2&nbsp;million was up
7&nbsp;percent from $34.9&nbsp;million a year ago. For the full year, revenues were unchanged at $701.5&nbsp;million and operating income increased 12&nbsp;percent to $144.8&nbsp;million. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Revenues in Oilfield Services of $93.1&nbsp;million for the quarter were down 12&nbsp;percent from $105.8&nbsp;million in the fourth quarter of last
year. Gross margins of 31.9&nbsp;percent increased by 1.8 percentage points from the same quarter last year on a richer sales mix. Operating income of $8.2&nbsp;million increased 9&nbsp;percent from $7.5&nbsp;million in the prior year period. For
the full year, revenues were down 19&nbsp;percent to $395.1&nbsp;million and operating income decreased 40&nbsp;percent to $23.3&nbsp;million. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Corporate costs of $16.0&nbsp;million decreased by $4.6&nbsp;million from last year driven by lower personnel related costs. The full year adjusted
effective tax rate for 2025 was 24.1&nbsp;percent compared to 26.4&nbsp;percent last year, due to the geographical mix of taxable profits. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">For the
quarter, cash provided by operating activities after capital expenditures was $40.9&nbsp;million compared to $5.1&nbsp;million a year ago. For the full year, cash from operations after capital expenditures was $63.9&nbsp;million compared to
$122.7&nbsp;million in 2024. As of December&nbsp;31, 2025, Innospec had net cash of $292.5&nbsp;million compared to net cash of $289.2&nbsp;million a year ago. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Mr.&nbsp;Williams concluded, </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">&#8220;Entering 2026,
our focus remains unchanged. We will continue to prioritize margin and operating income improvement in Performance Chemicals and Oilfield Services. In both segments, we have margin enhancement, new technology commercialization and other
opportunities which we expect to drive growth in 2026. In addition, we expect Fuel Specialties to continue to deliver consistent results. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Operating
cash generation was excellent in the quarter, and our net cash position closed at over $292&nbsp;million after making our semi-annual dividend payment of $21.6&nbsp;million. We enter 2026 with significant balance sheet flexibility for M&amp;A,
dividend growth, organic investment and buybacks.&#8221; </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>Use of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-GAAP</FONT> Financial Measures </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The information presented in this press release includes financial measures that are not calculated or presented in accordance with Generally Accepted
Accounting Principles in the United States (GAAP). These <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-GAAP</FONT> financial measures comprise adjusted EBITDA, income before income taxes excluding special items, net income excluding special items and related
per share amounts together with net cash. Adjusted EBITDA is net income/(loss) per our consolidated financial statements adjusted for the exclusion of interest income, net, income taxes, depreciation and amortization, pension scheme settlement
charge, recovery of historical pension costs, foreign currency exchange gains, legacy costs of closed operations, adjustment to fair value of contingent consideration, restructuring charge, impairment of property, plant and equipment and impairment
of intangible assets. Income before income taxes, net income and diluted EPS, excluding special items, per our consolidated financial statements are adjusted for the exclusion of impairment of property, plant and equipment, adjustment to fair value
of contingent consideration, impairment of intangible assets, impact of internal reorganizations, amortization of acquired intangible assets, legacy costs of closed operations, foreign currency exchange gains, restructuring charge, settlement charge
on UK pension scheme buy out, adjustment of income tax provisions, recovery of historical pension costs and settlement of historical tax audits. Net cash is cash and cash equivalents less total debt. Reconciliations of these <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-GAAP</FONT> financial measures to their most directly comparable GAAP financial measures are provided herein and in the schedules below. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">The Company believes that such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-GAAP</FONT> financial measures provide useful information to investors and may
assist them in evaluating the Company&#8217;s underlying performance and identifying operating trends. In addition, these <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-GAAP</FONT> measures address questions the Company routinely receives from analysts and
investors and the Company has determined that it is appropriate to make this data available to all investors. While the Company believes that such measures are useful in evaluating the Company&#8217;s performance, investors should not consider them
to be a substitute for financial measures prepared in accordance with GAAP. In addition, these <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-GAAP</FONT> financial measures may differ from similarly titled <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-GAAP</FONT>
financial measures used by other companies and do not provide a comparable view of the Company&#8217;s performance relative to other companies in similar industries. Management uses adjusted EPS (the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure
for which is GAAP EPS) and net income excluding special items and adjusted EBITDA (the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure for which is GAAP net income/(loss)) to allocate resources and evaluate the performance of the Company&#8217;s
operations and has provided a reconciliation of adjusted EBITDA and net income excluding special items, and related per share amounts, to GAAP net income/(loss) herein and in the schedules below. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>About Innospec Inc. </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">Innospec Inc. is an international
specialty chemicals company with approximately 2,450 employees in 22 countries. Innospec manufactures and supplies a wide range of specialty chemicals to markets in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific.&nbsp;The Performance
Chemicals business creates innovative technology-based solutions for our customers in the Personal Care, Home Care, Agrochemical, Mining and Industrial markets. The Fuel Specialties business specializes in manufacturing and supplying fuel additives
that improve fuel efficiency, boost engine performance and reduce harmful emissions. Oilfield Services provides specialty chemicals to all elements of the oil and gas exploration and production industry.</P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL"><B>Forward-Looking Statements </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL" ALIGN="justify">This press release contains
certain &#8220;forward-looking statements&#8221; within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995.&nbsp;All statements other than statements of historical facts included or incorporated herein may constitute forward-looking
statements.&nbsp;Such forward-looking statements include statements (covered by words like &#8220;expects,&#8221; &#8220;estimates,&#8221; &#8220;anticipates,&#8221; &#8220;may,&#8221; &#8220;could,&#8221; &#8220;believes,&#8221;
&#8220;feels,&#8221; &#8220;plans,&#8221; &#8220;intends,&#8221; &#8220;outlook&#8221; or similar words or expressions, for example) which relate to earnings, growth potential, operating performance, events or developments that we expect or
